'''2003 Chandrila State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Italy (June 2003). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms. Chandrila was the Players Committee region for Italy, and the 2003 event drew 18 players, up from 14 in 2002.<ref name="pcf-3364-46870">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46870#46870 Chandrila States (Italy)], David Destefanis, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041031011229/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46870%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Italy
* '''Dates:''' June 2003
